definitions.explanation: An aquatic animal, or fish as food.

examples.japanese: {魚|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}きました→焼く：01123_yaku⟧。

examples.english: I saw fish in the sea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎週|まいしゅう}→毎週：00730_maishuu⟧{魚|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{市場|いちば}→市場：01803_ichiba⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{行|い}きます→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: My father goes to the market to buy fish every week.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦たくさん→たくさん：00597_takusan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{魚|さかな}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦います→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦いけません→いけない：02335_ikenai⟧。
examples.english: There are many fish in this river, but you are not allowed to fish here.

notes:
{魚|さかな} refers to both fish as animals and fish as food.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {魚|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{釣|つ}る→釣る：01236_tsuru⟧: to catch fish
- {魚|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill fish
- {魚|さかな}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捌|さば}く→捌く：noentry⟧: to fillet fish
- ⟦{魚屋|さかなや}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧: fish shop, fishmonger

COMMON TYPES:
- ⟦{鮭|さけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧/⟦{鮭|しゃけ}→鮭：19337_sake⟧: salmon
- ⟦{鮪|まぐろ}→鮪：11134_maguro⟧: tuna
- ⟦{鯛|たい}→鯛：14709_tai⟧: sea bream
- ⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧: mackerel

CULTURE:
Fish is a staple of Japanese cuisine. Japan is one of the world's largest consumers of seafood per capita.

CONTRAST:
- {魚|さかな}: fish
- ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧: meat
